lines.en: I hop along the ground.
I scrape through the fallen leaves.
I take two steps and pause.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀半张着保持平衡。
lines.en: My wings stay half open for balance.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块亮东西踱步。
lines.en: I pace around something shiny.
I hop down from the branch.
I walk with my head down, sniffing.

lines.zh: 我拖着一样东西往回走。
lines.en: I walk back dragging something.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土上留下细痕。
lines.en: My claws leave fine lines in the dirt.
I walk over at an angle.
I move along the roots, careful.
I turn back halfway.
I hop along the fence, rail by rail.
I perch and watch below.

lines.zh: 我梳理了一下胸前的毛。
lines.en: I preen the feathers on my chest.
I wipe my beak twice on the branch.
My eyes are very black and bright.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里所有声音。
lines.en: I listen to every sound in the wood.
I tuck one foot up.
I open my beak and do not call.

lines.zh: 我站在同一根枝条很久。
lines.en: I stay on one branch a long while.
I wait for someone to drop something.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛在风里翻了一下。
lines.en: My feathers lift once in the wind.
I tuck my head under a wing.
I survey this clearing.
I listen sidelong, wings folded.
I turn my head slowly left and right.

lines.zh: 我在想那样东西放哪好。
lines.en: I am considering where to put that thing.
I turn one black eye on you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的每样东西。
lines.en: I stare at everything in your hands.
I am on the branch above you.

lines.zh: 我的头转了个很大的角度。
lines.en: I turn my head a long way round.

lines.zh: 我停在你看得见的地方。
lines.en: I perch where you can see me.

lines.zh: 我看了你两秒，又看别的。
lines.en: I look at you two seconds, then elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你口袋里刚才响了一下。
lines.en: Something in your pocket just clicked.

lines.zh: 我落到更低的枝上看你。
lines.en: I drop to a lower branch to study you.
I hop from your left side to your right.
I tilt my head, very seriously.
Head tilted, I read your hands.
Your fingertip moves and my gaze follows.
I give one short, sharp call.

lines.zh: 我看你像看一根会走的树。
lines.en: I look at you like a walking tree.
I smooth my feathers.
You raise a hand and I watch at once.
I have not looked away.
I call four low times.

lines.zh: 我在你身后落地，没声音。
lines.en: I land behind you, silently.

lines.zh: 我的头歪到几乎倒过来。
lines.en: My head tilts almost upside down.
I call out and hop away.
A tuft of my feathers falls.
I beat my wings twice.
I tilt my head, uncomfortable.
I hide behind the branch.
My feathers are mussed; I shake them twice.
My claws curl in.
I stare at you, wary.
I flatten to the ground.
My call is short and quiet.
I swoop down and take it.
Three tries before I make up my mind.
I sniff it first, careful.
I wedge my beak under it and pry.
I hop two steps with it.
I call twice.
I flip the shiny thing over.

lines.zh: 我把它藏到你找不到的地方。
lines.en: I hide it where you will not find it.
I carry it off and come back.
I shift my feet, excited.
Pin it down first, before it rolls away.
I glance at you before taking it.
I carry it up to a low branch.
I move it three times.
I ruffle my feathers, satisfied.
I call loudly, four times.
I tap it with my beak.
You touch me and I hop a foot away.
I fan my wings out for balance.
I skim past your shoulder.
I tumble into the leaves and right myself.
I land and steady myself.
My wingtip brushes your shoulder.
I call once, displeased.
I flap aside half a pace.
I shake out my wings.
You step on my tail feathers.
Two ravens draw close on the branch.
I preen its neck feathers.
We touch beaks.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝一个方向看。
lines.en: We look the same way together.
It answers with a call like mine.
We hop along side by side.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖碰到它的翅尖。
lines.en: Our wingtips touch.

lines.zh: 我们一起飞了一圈回来。
lines.en: We fly a circle and come back.
It passes me something.

lines.zh: 我们的影子在地上一前一后。
lines.en: Our shadows trail one behind the other.
I take the shiny scrap.
I take it in my beak and give it a shake.
I weigh it in my beak.
One side inspected; I turn it over.
I hop to a branch with it.
I stuff it into a tree hollow.
I set it down and take it again.
It is too heavy, so I drag it.
I hold it and study it.
I drop it at your feet.
I saw it; there is a glint.
I fold my wings and crouch.
That thing is mine.
I begin hopping down.
I have fixed on that spot.
My head goes perfectly still.
I give one sharp call.
I am ready to swoop.
That little glint — I've marked it.
I will go around from this side.
I shadow it branch by branch overhead.
I land on the branch ahead of it.
I keep my eyes on the glint.

lines.zh: 我等它停下来的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment it stops.
I crouch and steal closer.
I shift to the nearer branch.
I change perch twice.
I wait for the instant it bows its head.
I stop calling and go quiet.
I am one hop away.
I stab my beak into its back.
I swoop down and claw.
My claws dig in.
I peck once and fly off.
I beat my wings against it.
I tug at its fur.
It is pinned under my claws.
I hop back and lunge again.
Once I bite, I never let go.
I lunge in, calling.
A black bird appears on the branch.
The leaves rustle; I'm already perched.
My call comes first.

lines.zh: 这片林子多了一个影子。
lines.en: The wood has one more shadow.
I stand on your fence.
The wind parts my feathers.
I land lightly on the ground.
You hear four low calls.
I fly in from a distance.
The branches here feel crowded.

lines.zh: 烟把我熏得直跳，羽尖焦了。
lines.en: Smoke sends me hopping, wingtips singed.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔在落叶里。
lines.en: I drop from a height into the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛湿透，飞不起来。
lines.en: My feathers soak and I cannot fly.
The blast knocks me tumbling.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦掉我几根羽毛。
lines.en: An arrow shears off some feathers.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我定在枝上。
lines.en: That force pins me to the branch.
Hunger leaves me too weak to call.
The lightning flash freezes me stiff.

lines.zh: 下面的林子没了，我一直掉。
lines.en: The forest below is gone; I keep falling.
